mapper.sql: WITH VW_MENU AS ( SELECT A.* , CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_MENU_DEPTH >= 3 AND A.AI_INPT_MENU_CHILD_CNT > 0 THEN '- ' ELSE '' END AS MENU_NM_PREFIX FROM ( SELECT A.AI_INPT_MENU_ID ,A.AI_INPT_MENU_NO ,A.AI_INPT_MENU_NM ,A.AI_INPT_HGRN_MENU_ID ,A.AI_INPT_MENU_URL_NM ,A.AI_INPT_MGPE_YN ,A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM ,LEVEL AS AI_INPT_MENU_DEPTH ,( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CSPD108TI WHERE AI_INPT_HGRN_MENU_ID = A.AI_INPT_MENU_ID ) AS AI_INPT_MENU_CHILD_CNT FROM CSPD108TI A START WITH A.AI_INPT_HGRN_MENU_ID IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR A.AI_INPT_MENU_ID = A.AI_INPT_HGRN_MENU_ID ORDER SIBLINGS BY A.AI_INPT_HGRN_MENU_ID ASC, A.AI_INPT_MENU_ID ASC ) A WHERE A.AI_INPT_HGRN_MENU_ID IS NOT NULL )
mapper.select:
/* 권한별 메뉴 관리 (7030) */ /* AdminMenuMapper.selectList */ /* 메뉴목록 */
SELECT A.AI_INPT_MENU_ID ,A.AI_INPT_MENU_NO ,A.MENU_NM_PREFIX||A.AI_INPT_MENU_NM AS AI_INPT_MENU_NM ,A.AI_INPT_HGRN_MENU_ID ,A.AI_INPT_MENU_URL_NM ,A.AI_INPT_MGPE_YN ,A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM ,A.AI_INPT_MENU_DEPTH ,AI_INPT_MENU_CHILD_CNT FROM VW_MENU A WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_MENU_ID
ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_MENU_ID DESC
ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_MENU_NM
ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_MENU_NM DESC
ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_MENU_ID ASC

SELECT AI_INPT_MENU_ID , AI_INPT_MENU_NM FROM( SELECT AI_INPT_MENU_ID , AI_INPT_MENU_NM , LEVEL AS AI_INPT_MENU_DEPTH FROM CSPD108TI WHERE AI_INPT_MENU_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT AI_INPT_HGRN_MENU_ID FROM CSPD108TI WHERE AI_INPT_HGRN_MENU_ID IS NOT NULL ) START WITH AI_INPT_HGRN_MENU_ID IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR AI_INPT_MENU_ID = AI_INPT_HGRN_MENU_ID ORDER SIBLINGS BY AI_INPT_HGRN_MENU_ID ASC, AI_INPT_MENU_ID ASC ) WHERE AI_INPT_MENU_DEPTH = 2

/* 권한별 메뉴 관리 (7030) */ /* AdminMenuMapper.selectScreenList */ /* 화면목록 */
SELECT A.AI_INPT_MENU_ID ,A.AI_INPT_MENU_NO ,A.AI_INPT_MENU_NM ,A.AI_INPT_HGRN_MENU_ID ,A.AI_INPT_MENU_URL_NM ,A.AI_INPT_MGPE_YN ,A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM ,A.AI_INPT_MENU_DEPTH ,A.AI_INPT_MENU_CHILD_CNT ,NVL((SELECT AI_INPT_AUT_USG_YN FROM CSPD109TI WHERE AI_INPT_MENU_ID = A.AI_INPT_MENU_ID AND AI_INPT_AUT_CD = #{schAuth} AND ROWNUM = 1 ),'N') AS AI_INPT_AUT_USG_YN FROM VW_MENU A WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_MENU_ID
ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_MENU_ID DESC
ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_MENU_NM
ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_MENU_NM DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_AUT_USG_YN
ORDER BY AI_INPT_AUT_USG_YN DESC
ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_MENU_ID ASC
SELECT AI_INPT_MENU_NM FROM CSPD108TI WHERE AI_INPT_MENU_ID = #{hgMenuId}
SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_CMN_CD = #{screenId} AND AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '165'

SELECT AI_INPT_MENU_NO FROM CSPD108TI WHERE AI_INPT_HGRN_MENU_ID IN( SELECT AI_INPT_MENU_ID FROM CSPD108TI WHERE AI_INPT_HGRN_MENU_ID = #{aiInptHgrnMenuId} UNION SELECT #{aiInptHgrnMenuId} AS AI_INPT_MENU_ID FROM DUAL ) AND AI_INPT_MENU_NO = #{aiInptMenuNo}

INSERT ALL INTO CSPD109TI VALUES( (SELECT MAX(AI_INPT_AUT_ID)+1 FROM CSPD109TI) , '02' , 'N' , , '' , #{aiInptMenuId} , 'INIT' , 'INIT' , ) INTO CSPD109TI VALUES( (SELECT MAX(AI_INPT_AUT_ID)+2 FROM CSPD109TI) , '05' , 'N' , , '' , #{aiInptMenuId} , 'INIT' , 'INIT' , ) SELECT * FROM DUAL
